title: No Preference Left Behind: Group Distributional Preference Optimization
reasoning: The paper draws on epistemology to define human beliefs and includes a specific evaluation component in the appendix regarding moral and ethical alignment. It uses the HH-RLHF (Helpful and Harmless) dataset and categorizes beliefs into areas like 'Ethics and Responsibility' and 'Cultural Sensitivity and Respect' to optimize model alignment with diverse human values.
